name: block_transition
description: Complete the current block, start a next block, or do both with an idempotent revisioned transition.

name: health_get_diet_notes
description: Get diet notes for a date range.

block_id.description: Training block id; defaults to the active block.

name: health_get_supplements
description: Get the supplement protocol from the program.

block_id.description: Training block id; defaults to the active block.

name: program_get
description: Get a specific program version by its sort key. Returns the full program object with phases, sessions, meta, lift profiles, and competitions. Use this to load a program for display or before modifying it.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

block.description: Optional block id, or "current" for the active block.

window_start.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD session and competition window start.

window_end.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD session and competition window end.

name: program_list_full
description: List all program versions with full program objects (not just summaries) for a user. Includes resolved phases and sessions. Use include_archived=true to include archived versions.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Optional specific program sort key to filter to.

name: program_archive
description: Archive a program version by setting its archived flag. The version remains accessible via program_list with include_archived=true but is hidden from default views.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

name: program_unarchive
description: Unarchive a previously archived program version, restoring it to the default view.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

name: program_update_meta_field
description: Update a single top-level meta field on the current program (e.g. name, start_date, current_body_weight_kg, current_body_weight_lb). Reads the program, applies the field update, and writes it back.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

field.description: The meta field name to update (e.g. "name", "start_date", "current_body_weight_kg").

value.description: The new value for the field. Type depends on the field being updated.

updates.description: Multiple meta fields to update at once, keyed by field name.

name: program_update_phases
description: Update the phases array on a program version, or replace a single block within the phases. Reads the program, applies the phase/block update, and writes it back.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

block.description: Optional block key to update a single block within phases instead of replacing all.

name: block_notes_get
description: Get block notes for a program version. Block notes are free-form per-block commentary stored alongside the program.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

name: block_notes_update
description: Replace the block notes array for a program version. This is a full replace — send the complete array of block note dicts.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

block_notes.description: Full array of block note dicts to write.

name: diet_notes_update
description: Replace the diet notes array for a program version. Full replace — send the complete array of note dicts.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

name: supplement_phases_update
description: Replace the supplement phases array for a program version. Full replace — send the complete array of phase dicts.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

phases.description: Full array of supplement phase dicts to write.

name: export_program_markdown
description: Generate a markdown export of the current program and return its content as a string. Includes phases, sessions, meta, and analysis sections (deterministic only — AI sections excluded).

name: health_new_version
description: Create a new major version of the program. Copies the current program, applies patches to specific fields, and stores as a new version. Use this when making significant program changes that should be tracked as a separate version.

change_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the version change.

patches.description: List of patches, each with "path" and "value" keys. Example: {"path": "sessions[0].exercises[1].kg", "value": 180}

name: health_setup_initialize
description: Initialize a no-data user first training block for the active partition. Creates a blank program or applies a template depending on mode. Use when a new user needs their first program.

mode.description: Initialization mode: "blank" for empty program or "template" to apply a template.

week_start_day.description: Day of the week the training week starts on (e.g. "Monday").

template_sk.description: Template sort key to apply (required when mode is "template").

maxes.description: Initial maxes object with squat_kg, bench_kg, deadlift_kg.

name: health_setup_status
description: Return first-class setup state for the active health data partition. Indicates whether the user has a program, whether setup initialization is needed, and what step they are on.

name: health_invalidate_program_cache
description: Invalidate the program cache for the current user. Forces the next read to go to DynamoDB instead of the in-process LRU cache. Use after writes that must be immediately visible.
